firstLines: Hannah Brooks
Denver, CO | (303) 555-0148 | hannah.brooks@email.com | linkedin.com/in/hannahbrooksrn
SUMMARY
Registered nurse with four years on a 32-bed medical-surgical unit, including two years as relief charge
nurse. BSN, Colorado RN license, BLS and ACLS.
EXPERIENCE
St. Odile Medical Center Denver, CO
Registered Nurse (Med-Surg) Aug 2022 – Present
• Care for five to six adult patients per shift, including post-op, sepsis and diabetic patients
• Serve as relief charge nurse about six shifts a month, making assignments for nine nurses and handling
admissions
• Joined the unit's falls committee; hourly rounding changes we introduced cut falls from 11 to 4 in a year
• Precept new graduate nurses and have oriented seven through their first 12 weeks
Elkmeadow Rehabilitation Hospital Aurora, CO
Registered Nurse Jun 2021 – Jul 2022
• Managed medications and wound care for 12 rehab patients on day shift and documented every
assessment in Epic
• Taught patients and families how to manage new insulin and blood thinner routines before discharge
• Worked with physical therapists to plan safe discharges for stroke and joint replacement patients
EDUCATION
Pinyon Draw University Fort Collins, CO
Bachelor of Science in Nursing May 2021
• Sigma Theta Tau International Honor Society of Nursing
LICENSES AND SKILLS
License: Registered Nurse, Colorado (multistate compact)
Certifications: BLS, ACLS, NIH Stroke Scale
Clinical: Telemetry, wound care, IV therapy
Systems: Epic, Pyxis, Omnicell
